name: saarius-skills
description: Experimental agent skills, product decisions, and instructions for local Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse ACP delegation (MCP servers ship in the separate ai-shed plugin).

interface.shortDescription: Product decisions plus instructions for local Cursor, Antigravity, Grok, and Muse ACP delegation.
interface.longDescription: Experimental Agent Skills for cumulative product decisions, bounded implementation, verification, honest closeout, phone UI proof, and instructions for the local Cursor ACP, official Antigravity ACP, local Grok CLI ACP, and Muse ACP delegation routes. The MCP servers for those routes ship in the separate ai-shed plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me decide and build the next product slice with GrillTrack.
Use the SaariusSkills ACP plugin for one bounded implementation task.
Use Cursor ACP to delegate one bounded implementation slice after verifying the advertised model and effective permissions.
Use Antigravity ACP to diagnose setup or delegate one bounded slice using a verified advertised model.
Use Grok ACP to delegate one bounded implementation slice to local grok agent stdio after readiness verification.
Use Muse ACP to delegate one bounded implementation slice to local muse serve through the muse-agent-acp adapter after readiness verification.
